1.title: Ocasio-Cortez Donates to N.Y. Democrats, Will Barnstorm State Ahead of Midterms
1.summary: The news has reignited speculation about whether the progressive representative from the Bronx is considering a run for senator or president.

2.title: Abortion Rights Activists in Idaho Find Their Pitch: Bring Back the Doctors
2.summary: Organizers of a referendum to repeal an abortion ban in deep-red Idaho are far more focused on how the ban has broadly affected health care in the state.

3.title: Ashley Hinson, a Republican ‘Minivan-Driving Mom,’ Steers Away From Trump in Midterm Elections
3.summary: Representative Ashley Hinson is hoping to keep a crucial Senate seat red in Iowa, where the president has created major headwinds for her party.

4.title: Three dead and eight injured in Philippines school shooting
4.summary: The gunman is among the dead in what is the third school shooting in the country since June.

5.title: At least 16 killed in attack on mosque in Pakistan
5.summary: A vehicle loaded with explosives rammed into a mosque building during Friday prayers, a senior police official says.

6.title: Dozens of suspected illegal miners die in Nigerian custody
6.summary: Authorities linked the deaths to disease, but this has been disputed by intelligence reports and relatives of the accused.
